data: Which type of content do you wish was easier to find through the MeWe search function?
Pages | Groups and communities | Events | News and articles relevant to your interests | Specific users or influencers
Which of the following options would best help foster constructive political discussions on our platform?

Dedicated spaces for community-driven, respectful political dialogue | Resources to help users critically evaluate political information | Clearer guidelines on what constitutes respectful and constructive discussions | No changes are needed | Tools for users to more easily report inaccurate or harmful content
The most important thing to me is:
Staying away from Big Tech | Connecting with new people | An ad-free experience | Finding interesting content | Privacy
Which of these features needs the most improvement?
When using the search function on MeWe, what is your primary goal? Please select the option that best describes your most frequent use of this feature.
I use it to find a group I joined | Exploring specific topics that interest me | Finding new content | Finding friends or users I follow | Discovering new interesting groups
How do you feel about the discussions related to politics on our platform?

Often dominated by extreme viewpoints or misleading information | They negatively impact my experience on MeWe | I haven’t noticed any issues | Generally OK but could be more constructive | Respectful and informative
How do you support your favorite content creators?
I encourage others to follow them | I pay for subscriptions and exclusive perks | I engage with and share their content | I support by viewing and liking only
Where is it important to see posts with recent comments?
In my home feed | In both my home and group feeds | In my group feed
How easy do you find it to report inappropriate content on MeWe?
It could be simplified | It is user-friendly and efficient | I don't know how to report content | Straightforward, but could use some minor improvements | It is not good and should be improved
How do you stay connected to your closest friends on MeWe?
I wish there was a better way on MeWe | I only follow my closest friends | I use the "Favorites" function | I use the chat feature | We are all in a group together | I use voice and video
